item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena snaps a bar magnet into two equal pieces while doing an experiment at home in Jaipur. She says, "Now one small piece will have only a North pole and the other only a South pole."
What does she actually find when she tests each piece?

options.A: Each small piece has both a North pole and a South pole.
options.B: One piece has only a North pole and the other only a South pole.
options.C: Both pieces lose their magnetism completely.
options.D: Only the bigger piece keeps its poles; the smaller piece has none.
